email.subject: can you teach us?
email.body:
Femi wants to learn so we never lose a photo again. Our machine is logged in. Send us commands with write ada and we'll type them. There's a backup of the honeymoon photo hiding somewhere.

Ada & Femi

how.txt: sends one command to their machine.
they type it exactly. typos too.

remote.did_it: We found it! Femi did the typing. I did the cheering.

replies.right: We found the honeymoon photo ourselves. Forty years, two outages. We always bounce back.
replies.no_attachment: Don't send me a picture. Send me the commands. I want to do it myself.
